note: Two defects the live audit found, both in this release mechanism rather than in the pages. First: the token versioned CSS and JS but not assets/data, so the corrected 1956 testimonies — ten of fifteen re-paired with the right photographs — never reached a returning reader. The live page still opened Bódis-Wollner Iván on the plate that shows Farkas András. JSON references are versioned now. Second: the page pairs plate to testimony by array position, not by the image field, so a reordered but correctly labelled array would pass every check and still open the wrong life; the audit now requires plate order. Also: 26 standalone links measured 19–20px on mobile, under the 24px minimum.
